paymentUnavailable: This payment method is not connected to checkout yet. No charge will be made and the sale will not be recorded as cash.
wantFiscal: Does the customer want a tax receipt?
noFiscalRequest: Do not request on this screen
fiscalUnavailable: Tax issuance and identification are not connected to this checkout yet. Completion is blocked for this option so the customer’s request is not lost.
clubQuestion: Does the customer want to join the club?
clubNoPoints: This sale does not earn points yet; club integration is pending.
changeAfter: After confirmation, items, received amount and change remain on screen until the next sale.
pending: Result not confirmed yet. Check the same operation before another sale.
tenderUnknown: There is no reliable received-amount record for this sale. Check the receipt and cash before giving change.
fiscalNotIssued: Tax document: not issued by this checkout yet.
drawerNote: Purchase recorded. Automatic drawer opening requires configured hardware; this screen does not confirm physical opening.
finishSaleFirst: Complete or cancel the current sale before closing the register.
clubDraftNote: Local enrollment request, saved only on this computer and user access. It does not activate membership or generate points yet.
name: Full name
consent: The customer authorized recording these details to request club enrollment.
clubSaved: Request saved on this computer. Membership and points still await integration.
discardClub: There are unsaved details. Leave without saving the request?
invalidClub: Check name, CPF and customer authorization.
clubStorageError: Could not save or delete the request. Try again.
invalidTender: Could not preserve the received amount. No new sale was submitted.
tenderConflict: The received amount differs from this operation’s earlier record. Check the pending operation.
_review: pt-BR source; other languages require native review before production.
